scope: Selected survival slice: natural starvation, room-driven hypothermia/heatstroke, capacity loss, irreversible death, physical rescue between levels, feeding from actual cargo, interrupted saves and genuine v9 migration. Normal-command campaigns and browser UI checks do not establish full original-game equivalence, clothed tolerance, all-biome long-term balance or complete medicine. Native observations and static rules remain separate evidence.

baseline.scope: Legacy-world continued-play regression. Generation-2 creation is verified separately.

campaign.scope: Public commands, elapsed-calendar step and normal save/load only. A genuinely published colony builds an underground isolation room and upstairs medical bed. A locked door prevents one colonist from reaching food; after natural collapse, unlocking permits real cross-level rescue and feeding. No health, terrain, food, need, temperature or clock injection. Temperature consequences are verified by the separate temperature campaign.

food.scope: Public command/step/save/load only, with normal day/night time progression. No resource injection, mature-crop injection, terrain editing, pawn teleportation or direct tick changes. Nominal edible nutrition explicitly includes the recipe gain: 10 grain at 0.05 becomes one 0.9 meal, adding 0.4 nutrition per cooked meal. This does not claim physical calorie conservation or unlimited colony sustainability.

housing.scope: Normal command/step/save/load only; no world, resource, need or time injection. Headless elapsed calendar simulation, not real-time native play.

power.scope: Normal command/step/save/load only. No injected terrain, resources, devices, fuel, energy, needs or time. Seed terrain inspected to plan finite ore excavation; headless calendar simulation, not native real-time measurement.

preservation.scope: Normal command/step/save/load only. Continues a freshly generated normal power campaign with mined finite resources; no injected food, age, temperature, fuel, energy, position or time. Crops grow through natural calendar cycles, ingredients are hauled and cooked. Frozen and power-off branches start from the same physical save. Accelerated Node ticks are not real-time native observations.

logistics.scope: Normal command/step/save/load only, no injected resources, terrain, needs, items or time. Finite ground stacks, physical hauling, full storage, changed filters, expansion and cross-level transfer. Separately imports an unchanged save from the previously published v5 normal preservation campaign.

stonecutting.scope: Normal commands, step, save and load. No injected resources, blocks, needs, pawn positions, task progress or time. Excavate native-inspired probabilistic chunks, carry them up actual ladders, build and operate a stonecutter, then deliver its bricks into upper-floor construction. Separately migrate unchanged published v6 gameplay bytes.

worldgen.scope: Fresh generator-2 worlds. Public command/step/save/load; read-only block/path/standability inspection chooses actual work sites. No terrain, resource, pawn, progress or time injection. Three bounded opening campaigns, not long-term survival proof.

plants.scope: Fresh generator-2 desert colony with selected warm/wet climate. Public command/step/save/load only; read-only terrain/path inspection chooses actual sites. No injected materials, trees, maturity, terrain, pawn needs or clock. This verifies one bounded planting lifecycle with food production, not all-biome long-term balance.

layers.scope: Headless rules campaign through public command/step/save/load APIs. No terrain editing, inventory injection, pawn teleportation, or renderer used as gameplay proof.

worldgenBrowser.scope: Real Chrome controls and canvas clicks in Worker and main rendering modes. Only read-only snapshot/project/exportSave access. Preview must not mutate the current colony; new maps must match displayed settings; actual cutting, save reload and genuine v7 import.

legacy.scope: Legacy-world continued-play regression. Generation-2 creation is verified separately.

lifecycle.scope: Chrome headless, DPR 1; one document without reload, six normal UI save/new-world/load cycles. Only read-only window.voxel.snapshot/exportSave/project observation. Renderer must remain Worker WebGL2. Render geometry/texture counts are live Three.js resources; terrainGeometryBytes counts tracked terrain buffers, not total GPU memory. CDP Performance JSHeapUsedSize/JSHeapTotalSize covers the main page isolate only, excluding simulation/render workers, native browser allocations and VRAM. This bounded lifecycle run is not a long-duration leak proof or universal capacity estimate.
